risks: Seven committed answer HTML files are not emitted by the current build_geo_site.py generator; a successful build therefore does not reconcile their contents with current source data.

Five of the seven legacy pages are linked from geo/answers/index.html; two are absent from that index. All seven are included in the current source sitemap, while none are listed in the current geo/llms.txt answer section.

The sitemap assigns the global UPDATED date 2026-11-15 to all discovered URLs, including legacy files whose latest recorded Git changes are 2026-10-31 or 2026-11-06. This is a build-date stamp, not a per-file content-change record.
The legacy HTML files embed canonical URLs under the historical GitHub Pages namespace; that does not prove live public serving or current authorization to deploy.

Legacy page text contains short-order product pricing in broad task-answer routes. The values and current eligibility are not revalidated here; this audit does not treat them as current commercial terms.
